limitations: pyg_lib not available - using pure PyTorch implementations for GNN operations
No GPU detected - all computation on CPU
Full dynamic graph training across all snapshots was infeasible due to time constraints - single snapshot used
GNN message passing over full graphs (1M nodes) is computationally expensive on CPU
fallbacks: GNN training limited to 1 snapshot and 30 epochs instead of full temporal training
Edge classifier trained on disentangled features as primary DIDS-MFL evaluation
Graph windows increased to 12h (from 1h) to reduce number of snapshots
SVM trained on 10K subset due to O(n^2) kernel complexity

named_method_fidelity.statistical_disentanglement: PCA+ICA hybrid instead of SMT-based MI optimization from 3D-IDS. Rationale: SMT solvers not available; PCA+ICA achieves comparable decorrelation and independence maximization.
named_method_fidelity.representational_disentanglement: Factor-wise GAT + covariance regularization approximates the representational disentanglement from 3D-IDS.
named_method_fidelity.dynamic_graph_diffusion: Simplified GNN aggregation replacing the full non-linear graph diffusion from 3D-IDS.
named_method_fidelity.multi_scale_fusion: Bi-similarity prototype network adapted from BSNet few-shot learning framework.
